name: @repo/entitlements
description: Shared tier-entitlement resolution. Pure functions that read `tenant_entitlement_override` + `billing` and return effective boolean/numeric values. Used by both the cloud gateway (Cloudflare Worker) and the tenant dashboard (Next.js). Consumers supply their own Supabase client (admin, scoped, or otherwise). Tier values come from `@repo/tier-config`; this package owns the resolution rules but not the matrix.
